results.strFilename: UEFA Champions League 2026-11-03 Barcelona vs Aston Villa
results.strDescriptionEN: Barcelona host Aston Villa at Spotify Camp Nou in a key Champions League Matchday 4 fixture. Villa arrive with three wins from three in the league phase, while Barcelona look to respond after their defeat to Paris Saint-Germain. With both sides pushing for a strong position in the table, the match carries clear qualification significance.
results.strResult: Barcelona defeated Aston Villa 3-1 at Spotify Camp Nou to strengthen their position in the Champions League league phase. Lamine Yamal and Raphinha were among the key attacking figures as Barça responded strongly after their previous European setback. Villa suffered their first defeat of the competition after entering the match with three wins from three.
